findings.classification: missing validation coverage; false acceptance not reproduced
findings.title: Physical estimator snapshot source, quality, and time metadata lack validator checks
findings.trigger: On a writer-produced estimator diagnostic, alter physical_candidate_vapor_source and physical_candidate_vapor_quality to 2147483647, or set physical_candidate_vapor.valid_time to 1 while leaving all numerical arrays untouched.
findings.expected: The validator reports a source/quality bit or valid-time identity failure for the physical candidate snapshot, or explicitly declares these attributes outside the assessment contract.
findings.actual: The validator source omits _quality, _source and valid_time from physical snapshot required fields/checks. On the available PR73 estimator artifact, setting physical_candidate_vapor_source and _quality to 2147483647, or setting physical_candidate_vapor.valid_time=1, added no failures. However, the artifact baseline was already numerical INVALID / UNBOUND / REJECTED with 15 failures, so this probe does not reproduce false acceptance.

evidence.detail: Writer stores physical background/candidate thermofields through put_thermo_field.
put_thermo_field serializes value, valid, quality, source, units, and valid_time.
Physical-state required bundle contains values, valid arrays and dry mass only.
Snapshot equality compares values and valid arrays, not quality/source/time.

findings.impact: The physical-contract validator does not assess serialized source/quality/time consistency. The available mutation probe does not establish that an otherwise numerically passing artifact would be accepted; treat this as missing validation coverage pending a numerically passing fixture.
findings.next_check: Add a focused validator corruption case for physical candidate source, quality, and valid_time; decide whether each is part of the physical assessment receipt and cross-bind it to the canonical candidate or reject unsupported attributes.

findings.classification: receipt completeness gap; intended standalone rejection is confirmed
findings.title: Estimator blocked stage receipts are only partly preserved in NetCDF
findings.trigger: Serialize the estimator endpoint through write_shadow_diagnostics.
findings.expected: If the artifact is intended to preserve producer receipts, persist enough stage status/reason fields to reconstruct the in-memory blocked FAILED/AUTHORITY decision, including overall and geopotential receipts.
findings.actual: The writer stores pipeline_status/reason, column_status, and balance_status. It does not store column_reason, balance_reason, overall status/reason, or geopotential status/reason. In-memory writer admission checks these receipts for coherence before writing. The standalone validator requires column_status OK, pipeline status DEGRADED/OK, and rejection reason GATE; it therefore rejects this FAILED/AUTHORITY estimator artifact as intended by the stated standalone policy.

evidence.detail: In-memory estimator coherence requires pipeline, column, balance, overall, and geopotential FAILED/AUTHORITY.
Serialized stage metadata is limited to pipeline status/reason, column status, and balance status.
Standalone validator retains accepted/degraded producer assumptions and rejects failed authority status.
Standalone output remains UNBOUND and candidate is REJECTED unless accepted and failure-free.

findings.reproduction: Available PR73 estimator artifact has pipeline_status=-10, pipeline_reason=9, column_status=-10, balance_status=-10, physical feasibility PASS, and physical_analysis_increment_v1. Current standalone validation returns numerical INVALID, artifact UNBOUND, candidate REJECTED with 15 failures. The mentioned verified-physical-shadow.nc was not present in that OEV run directory.
findings.impact: The NetCDF alone cannot serve as a complete status/reason receipt for all in-memory estimator stages. No standalone admission occurs; its rejection is expected.
findings.next_check: Add an explicit estimator receipt schema/extension if downstream reviewers need to distinguish a deliberately blocked estimator assessment from an ordinary failed producer result, and assert round-trip status/reason coherence. Keep standalone candidate decision REJECTED/UNBOUND.
